# High Signal — full agent brief

Daily evidence-first brief across markets, business opportunities, and behavior — source roles, direct hit-rate history, and no signup required.

## Index

# High Signal

Daily synthesized intelligence brief on technology, startups, and finance.

## What it is

- Three-category public edition at `/`; `/brief` permanently redirects there
- Inline direct hit-rates on market calls after the exact signal type earns a reliable sample
- Public track record and methodology pages
- Free, no signup for the brief

## Who it's for

Operators and investors who want a high-signal daily read instead of raw feed noise.
